import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_53/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_53/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_53/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# The operation history shows a join between Source1 and Source2 on 'Athlete'
# The intermediate result is already saved in intermediate_step1.csv, but we will re-derive it here for completeness and correctness
# Join Source1 and Source2 on 'Athlete' (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source1, source2, on="Athlete", how="inner")

# Now join the above result with Source0 on 'Athlete' to get the 'Sport' column for all athletes
# Because Source0 has 'Athlete' and 'Sport', and joined already has 'Athlete' and other columns except 'Sport'
final_df = pd.merge(joined, source0, on="Athlete", how="inner")

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order:
# ['Athlete': string, 'Age': float, 'Year': integer, 'Closing Ceremony Date': string,
#  'Gold Medals': integer, 'Silver Medals': integer, 'Bronze Medals': integer,
#  'Total Medals': integer, 'Country': string, 'Sport': string]

# Convert columns to correct types:
final_df['Age'] = final_df['Age'].astype(float)
final_df['Year'] = final_df['Year'].astype(int)
final_df['Gold Medals'] = final_df['Gold Medals'].astype(int)
final_df['Silver Medals'] = final_df['Silver Medals'].astype(int)
final_df['Bronze Medals'] = final_df['Bronze Medals'].astype(int)
final_df['Total Medals'] = final_df['Total Medals'].astype(int)

# Closing Ceremony Date is string, keep as is (format looks like MM/DD/YYYY)
final_df['Closing Ceremony Date'] = final_df['Closing Ceremony Date'].astype(str)

# Country and Sport are strings, ensure string type
final_df['Country'] = final_df['Country'].astype(str)
final_df['Sport'] = final_df['Sport'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns exactly as target schema
final_df = final_df[['Athlete', 'Age', 'Year', 'Closing Ceremony Date', 'Gold Medals',
                     'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals', 'Country', 'Sport']]

# Save the final dataframe to the target path
final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_53/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
